notes.title: Patch 1 for version 1.1 was released
notes.content:
List of changes:
-Screen resolution settings have been added
-Bugs with hero freezing in Akiptown.exe and Bunker.exe have been fixed

notes.title: Update 1.1 has been released (achievements and commands)
notes.content:
What was added:
- full support for achievements
- some funny and secret commands to the terminal
- several hints in different parts of the game
- reviews from the final part were translated
Some bugs that were at release were also fixed.
